meta.name: image-to-code
meta.description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计图转化为精确的网站代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从设计图生成高质量网页代码
copy.tagline_en: Convert design images into precise website code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality website code from design images

howto.what: 当你要做视觉要求高的网页时,Claude 会先生成设计图,再仔细分析图里的文字、排版、间距、颜色和按钮,最后照着图写出前端代码。
howto.when: 当你要求做 hero 区、落地页或网站重设计等以视觉为主的任务,且环境支持图像生成时会触发。纯技术类任务、修 bug 不走这个流程。

say.text: 帮我做一个高质感落地页,先生成设计图再写代码
say.note: 会按区块逐张生成设计图,再照图实现

say.text: hero 区做得干净、留白大,小笔记本上也要看得清
say.note: 会减少首屏信息、放大留白

say.text: 首页那张图文字太小,定价区单独重出一张大图
say.note: 会以同样设计语言重出更清晰的版本

howto.what_en: For visually important web pages, Claude first generates design images, deeply analyzes text, type, spacing, color and buttons, then writes frontend code to match them.
howto.when_en: Triggers on visually driven web tasks like hero sections, landing pages or redesigns when image generation is available. Mostly technical tasks or bug fixes do not use this flow.

say_en.text: Build a premium landing page: generate the design images first, then code
say_en.note: Generates one image per section, then implements from them
